detectionStatistics.methodsAreas: Areas and perimeters come from each instance mask’s outline (shoelace formula); objects without a mask use their box. Coverage sums mask areas, so overlapping masks count twice.
detectionStatistics.methodsClarkEvans: Clark–Evans R = mean observed nearest-neighbour distance between centroids ÷ the expectation under complete spatial randomness, with Donnelly’s (1978) edge correction for the image rectangle. R '<' 1 suggests clustering, R '>' 1 regular spacing; z tests R = 1 (two-sided).
detectionStatistics.methodsDiameter: Equivalent diameter = 2√(A/π). Circularity = 4πA/P² (1 for a circle). Aspect ratio = the box’s long side over its short side. SD is the sample standard deviation; CV = SD/mean; IQR is the 25th–75th percentile.
detectionStatistics.methodsQuadrat: Quadrat analysis counts centroids in a grid with five cells on the image’s shorter side. Variance/mean (index of dispersion) is 1 under randomness; (q − 1)·VMR follows χ² with q − 1 degrees of freedom (two-sided test). Morisita’s I<sub>δ</sub> is 1 under randomness, above 1 when clustered.
detectionStatistics.methodsSample: Statistics cover model detections at or above the confidence filter, and every hand-tagged (manual) or hand-corrected (edited) object. Edited and hand-drawn outlines are smooth curves through their control points; their measurements come from those curves. Confidence statistics leave out manual objects. With fewer than five objects the tests are not interpreted.
detectionStatistics.methodsSizesPx: Sizes are in pixels; set a scale to measure in physical units.

setup.agenticReviewDescription: Plans and drafts changes that address a document’s comments.

setup.detectionDescription: Finds, outlines and counts objects in photos with Ultralytics’ YOLOE-26, on this computer. Describe what to find in words, or draw examples on the photo or on a reference image. Open it with the scan button in the photo viewer and the Image Gallery. Changes apply to the next run, without restarting.
setup.detectionModelDescription: The prompt models for text and visual prompts. The tool can switch variants for a run; each downloads the first time it is used.
setup.detectionNothingDownloaded: Nothing downloaded yet. Libera offers the download the first time you detect.
setup.deviceHelp: The CPU works everywhere and takes well under a second per photo for the smaller variants. The GPUs are faster for the larger variants, where PyTorch supports them.
setup.dictationEngineHelp: Spoken prompts are short, so a fast engine suits them even when voice memos use a more accurate one.
setup.dictationLanguageHelp: Language takes a code such as en or vi; empty uses the voice memo language (or detects it).
setup.displayMathMarkersLabel: Display math markers (on their own lines)
setup.downloadsDescription: A private Python runtime and the model weights, kept in one folder.
setup.downloadsHelp: The first time you detect, Libera offers to download a private Python runtime with PyTorch and Ultralytics (about 1 GB, installed by uv into this folder, nothing system-wide), MobileCLIP2-B for text prompts (254 MB) and the chosen variant’s weights from Ultralytics’ GitHub releases. Ultralytics and the YOLOE-26 weights are licensed AGPL-3.0.
setup.editorAndPreviewDescription: The toolbar zoom multiplies this size; at 100%, Markdown text uses it.
setup.embeddingGemmaDescription: Understands what notes and photos are about. Leave both fields empty to use Libera’s download.
setup.embeddingIntervalHelp: Measured from the end of the previous attempt. New passages are embedded with the next keyword update after this time. Update index bypasses this interval.
setup.embeddingIntervalLabel: Minimum time between automatic embedding updates
setup.embeddingOnAcHelp: Also applies to manual updates. On battery, or when power status is unavailable, embeddings wait. Keyword search keeps updating.
setup.embeddingOnlyOnAcLabel: Only update embeddings while connected to power
setup.embeddingSizeHelp: Smaller vectors make the index smaller and searches faster. Changing the size re-embeds everything.
setup.encryptBackupDescription: Enter your master password. The exported file is encrypted with it, and loading it later needs the same password.
setup.endpointInUse: {name} is in use by {users}. Choose another model there first.
setup.engineAndSpeedDescription: Kokoro runs on the CPU and nothing leaves the computer. OpenRouter receives the text a few sentences at a time and bills per character.
setup.equationMarkersDescription: One opening and closing pair per line, separated by a space. Use literal punctuation, not regular expressions; leave one empty to turn that type off.
setup.equationMarkersHelp: These apply to visual editing and Source Editor rendering; recognized markers are preserved when saving. Save preferences and restart the app to apply changes.

setup.exportedThemesStatus: Exported {count, plural, one {# theme} other {# themes}} to {fileName}.

setup.fallbackModelHelp: Used only when a non-LaTeX function-specific model is unavailable. LaTeX/PDF keeps its own fallback.
setup.ffmpegHelp: Reads M4A, MP3, OGG, FLAC and other recording formats. Without it, macOS reads them with its own converter and other systems read WAV only. Dictation does not need it.
setup.fileLoadedStatus: File loaded. Save preferences to keep this prompt.
setup.fontAccessDenied: Font access was not allowed. Try again and grant access.
setup.generalDescription: Personalize Libera and configure your local data directory, API key, and master password.
setup.generateDefinitionsDescription: The Agent run behind Generate definitions in the Definitions tab. It uses AI Chat’s routing. Changes apply without restarting.
setup.homepageIllustrationsDescription: The picture across the top of each notebook’s homepage. Choose a set; right-click a set of your own to edit or delete it.
setup.illustrationHint: Each notebook takes an illustration from the chosen set at random. To pick one for a notebook, open its homepage and choose New → Change illustration.
setup.illustrationSetDescription: Illustrations are cropped to 3:1, the shape of a notebook cover. Click one to pan, zoom and crop it.
setup.importedThemesStatus: Imported {count, plural, one {# theme} other {# themes}} from {fileName}. Save Preferences to keep {count, plural, one {it} other {them}}.
setup.indexFileHelp: By default the index stays on this computer, outside the Master directory, so a notes folder synced to the cloud never uploads it. setup.indexPhotosHelp: Notebook images and the Image Gallery, using the vision encoder.
setup.inferenceDescription: How detections are kept and how closely photos are examined.
setup.inferenceSizeHelp: The photo’s longer side is resized to the inference size before detection; larger sizes find smaller objects such as cells or seeds.
setup.ioDescription: Back up all settings shown in Preferences or restore them from a Libera JSON backup.
setup.ioWarningHelp: The backup contains sensitive data, including your API key and master password verifier, so it is encrypted with your master password. Loading it needs the master password it was exported with. The active login session secret is never exported.
setup.iouHelp: How much two boxes may overlap before the weaker is suppressed (default 0.7).
setup.keywordIntervalHelp: Saves and outside edits are collected and indexed together once this time has passed. Longer waits use less CPU; Update index applies changes at once.
setup.keywordIntervalLabel: Minimum time between automatic keyword updates
setup.kokoroDescription: Voices for kokoro-multi-lang-v1_0, grouped by accent.

setup.kokoroNotDownloaded: Not downloaded yet. Libera offers the download the first time you read aloud.

setup.localLlmNoteTools: Web search and Convert PDF to Markdown need an OpenRouter model, and Agent mode needs a model that can call tools.

setup.narrowProvidersHelp: Both narrow the providers available, so some models may stop working.

setup.openAlexKeyHelp: Without a key, OpenAlex allows about 100 title searches a day; a free key from openalex.org gives ten times more. When the quota is used up, lookups go on with Crossref alone.
setup.openBackupDescription: Enter the master password {fileName} was exported with. It becomes this profile's master password once the backup is loaded.

setup.otherFeaturesDescription: These name their own model, outside the pool.
setup.ownVoicesHelp: Each model has its own voices; the list suggests the chosen model’s. Empty uses the provider’s default, where it has one.
setup.passwordChangeHelp: Password changes are applied after restarting Libera Editor.
setup.pdfCleanupHelp: Pages are read separately, so their headings can disagree. When every page is in, the model gets the list of headings, not the text, and makes their levels consistent. Choose a model that reads PDF or image input. Changes apply without restarting.
setup.pdfEngineHelp: The local model sends nothing off this computer but takes one to three minutes a page. An OpenRouter model reads several pages at once, each sent as a one-page PDF, using your OpenRouter key.
setup.pdfExportDescription: Controls Markdown PDF export only and does not affect the editor.
setup.pdfExportLineHeightHelp: Use a unitless line-height ratio for exported PDFs.
setup.pdfReadingFolderHelp: The first time you use either feature, Libera offers to download it (about 600 MB) into this folder, or into its application data when the field is empty. Or put the files from Hugging Face (onnx-community/granite-docling-258M-ONNX) in a folder yourself, laid out like the repository: the configs and tokenizer at the top, and vision_encoder, embed_tokens and decoder_model_merged weights in onnx/.

setup.pdfThemeHelp: The PDF viewer and the LaTeX PDF preview draw pages on the theme’s page color. PDF text is nearly always black, so a page too dark for it uses the theme’s light page instead, or white.
setup.pdfToMarkdownDescription: Reads PDF pages into Markdown, on this computer or with an OpenRouter model.

setup.preferencesDescription: Change Libera Editor settings. Theme changes apply immediately when saved. Other changes apply after restarting Libera Editor.
setup.promptCachingNote: Enabled routes only to caching-capable providers and adds explicit cache breakpoints where supported, including Gemini. Cache writes may cost extra and expire; repeated context is needed for savings. Disabled removes cache breakpoints and routing restrictions, but providers may still cache automatically. With caching on, routing still applies among the caching providers.

setup.recordingRecapDescription: Keeps the bullet-point summary of a recording as it goes on. A small, quick model is enough.
setup.referencesDescription: Fills in reference metadata from PDFs and notes when no catalogue has it.
setup.resetCropTitle: Fit the whole width or height
setup.routingBalancedDetail: OpenRouter’s default: spreads requests over reliable providers, favouring lower prices.
setup.routingCheapestAcceptableSpeedDetail: The cheapest provider that keeps up with the minimum speed below.
setup.routingCheapestDetail: Lowest price per token. Speed varies by provider.
setup.routingFastestFirstResponseDetail: Shortest wait for the first token. Feels quickest in chat and short edits.
setup.routingFastestGenerationDetail: Most tokens per second, so long answers finish soonest.
setup.routingFastestWithinBudgetDetail: The fastest provider under the price ceilings you set below.
setup.routingMultiSubtitle: One routing strategy for the functions you choose. Only routing changes; models, reasoning effort and caching stay as they are.
setup.routingPrefersLatency: prefers under {seconds} s to first token
setup.routingPriceHint: Providers above a price ceiling are never used; the request fails instead. Speed and wait preferences only move slower providers to the back of the line.
setup.routingPriceSummary: {model} lists {input} input and {output} output per million tokens; providers may charge more or less. {hint}
setup.routingSingleSubtitle: How OpenRouter picks a provider for {model}. Only routing changes; the model and other settings stay as they are.
setup.scopeSourceEditors: the Markdown source and code editors
setup.searchDescription: Global Search finds notes, PDFs, LaTeX, code and images by meaning with Google’s EmbeddingGemma 2, running on this computer. Keyword search works without it. Changes apply without restarting.
setup.setupDescription: Choose the fixed Libera Editor Master directory, enter the required API key, and create the master password used by the app login screen.
setup.showWhereLeftOffLabel: Show where you left off on notebook homes
setup.signInFirstStatus: Sign in first to manage users. Close Preferences and enter your master password on the sign-in screen.
setup.skipProvidersLabel: Skip providers that may store or train on prompts
setup.smartPasteDescription: Fits pasted Markdown into the document’s outline.
setup.smartPasteHelp: When pasted Markdown has headings, match its top heading level to the document’s and continue the document’s heading numbering. Works in the visual and source editors.
setup.sourceEditorDescription: The editor used for Markdown Source mode and slide decks.
setup.sourceEditorHelp: CodeMirror (beta) adds syntax colours for Markdown and Libera’s highlights, boxes and math. Restart Libera after changing it.
setup.speakersDescription: Runs on this computer with either engine: pyannote segmentation-3.0 finds who speaks when, and a speaker embedding groups the voices.
setup.speakersHelp: A known count separates voices more reliably. Each recording can also be given its own when you transcribe it.
